BTS Group Hosts the 18th “Nuduan Vegetarian Food Festival” “Eat Good, Feel Good, Do Good” Invites the Public to Make Merit and Find Joy at BTS National Stadium Station

Back 12 October 2026

BTS Group, in collaboration with Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA), Saha Group, MBK Center, and Siam Piwat Co., Ltd., officially opened the 18th “Nuduan Vegetarian Food Festival” under the theme “Eat Good, Feel Good, Do Good,” inviting members of the public to observe the Vegetarian Festival, purify both body and mind, and enjoy quality vegetarian food. The opening ceremony was attended by Mr.Supot Lajumsil, Deputy Director, General of Traffic and Transportation, Bangkok Metropolitan Administration; Dr. Atchaka Sibunruang, Independent Director of BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited; Mr. Surapong Laoha-Unya, Chief Executive Officer and Mr.Chitchanok Kemavuthanon, Independent Director of Bangkok Mass Transit System Public Company Limited; Mr. Ian Craig Longden, Chief Executive Officer of Super Turtle Public Company Limited; Ms. Puttachad Srinisakorn, Chief Marketing Officer of MBK Public Company Limited; M.L. Auradis Snidvongs, Executive Vice President, Corporate Affairs of Siam Piwat Company Limited; and Ms. Thaninthorn Chokwatana, Head of Chairman Office and Corporate Governance, Saha Pathana Inter-Holding Public Company Limited.

Dr. Atchaka said, “The ‘Nuduan Vegetarian Food Festival’ has been held continuously for 18 years, reflecting the strong collaboration between BTS Group and its partners in continuing an initiative that benefits society. This year’s event is held under the theme ‘Eat Good, Feel Good, Do Good,’ inviting the public to observe the Vegetarian Festival, make merit, find joy, and take care of their health. The organizers also place great importance on safety and the environment by choosing food packaging made from natural sugarcane bagasse. We therefore invite passengers and members of the public travelling through BTS National Stadium Station (W1) to receive free vegetarian food throughout the three-day event, from 12–14 October 2026.”

Mr. Surapong added, “This year, the event’s partners have prepared a total of 8,000 vegetarian meal boxes to distribute to the public free of charge. BTS Group has selected a variety of popular vegetarian dishes, including Vegetarian Pad Prik Khing with Rice, Vegetarian Five-Spice Stew, Rice with Stir-Fried Shiitake Mushrooms and Soft Tofu, Vegetarian Larb with Rice, Vegetarian Drunken Spaghetti, and Vegetarian Stir-Fried Instant Noodles. In support of environmental conservation and efforts to reduce global warming, we also invite the public to travel by BTS SkyTrain to the ‘Nuduan Vegetarian Food Festival’ and join us in making merit, looking after their health, and caring for the environment.”

Mr. Ian said, “Super Turtle is delighted to once again be part of this valuable social initiative. This year, the company has provided 3,050 Mushroom-filled Vegetarian Onigiri from Turtle Shop for members of the public attending the event throughout all three days. This reflects the company’s commitment to providing delicious, convenient-to-carry vegetarian food that fits into people’s everyday lives, while encouraging them to take care of their health as they travel.”

Ms. Puttachad said, “MBK Center is pleased to have continued supporting the ‘Nuduan Vegetarian Food Festival.’ We believe that this long-standing tradition offers people an opportunity to make merit, refrain from harming or killing animals, and share goodwill and kindness with one another through food prepared with care and dedication. This year, MBK Center is contributing quality vegetarian dishes from Rabiang Boon, Cheng Sim Ei at the Food Legends by MBK food court, and Pathumwan Princess Hotel, all of which are part of the MBK Group, so that members of the public can enjoy the festival and make merit throughout the event. We remain committed to being a place for meaningful lifestyles and positive experiences for everyone.”

M.L. Auradis said, “Siam Piwat continues to pursue its commitment to running a business that benefits people, communities, and society through a platform of opportunities that enables everyone to grow. We are delighted to join forces with BTS Group, together with public- and private-sector partners, in continuing our participation in the ‘Nuduan Vegetarian Food Festival.’ This year, we are contributing two vegetarian dishes from JUMBO Seafood at Siam Paragon, which will be served to the public free of charge from 12–14 October 2026. We would like to invite everyone to make merit during the 2026 Vegetarian Festival by abstaining from meat and conducting themselves in accordance with moral principles, thereby cultivating merit while also taking care of their health through exercise.”

Ms. Thaninthorn said, “On behalf of Saha Group, I am delighted to take part in the 18th ‘Nuduan Vegetarian Food Festival’ under the theme ‘Eat Good, Feel Good, Do Good.’ The theme conveys three important messages. Eat Good means choosing vegetarian food that is good, high-quality, clean, and safe. Feel Good means taking care of both body and mind to stay refreshed, healthy, and happy. Do Good means doing good deeds, making merit, sharing, and passing on positive things to others. Through this initiative, we can turn every meal into an opportunity to care for our health, turn our good intentions into a force for kindness, and share merit and happiness with those around us. ‘Eat Good, Feel Good, Do Good’—let us enjoy quality vegetarian food, make merit, find happiness, and pass on good things together.”

For the latest news and updates, please follow the BTS SkyTrain Facebook Page and LINE Official Account: @btsskytrain. To check train service status, please use the ‘THE SKYTRAINs’ application, or contact the BTS Customer Relations Center at 02-617-6000 for further information.
